name: Hydrochloric Acid
uses: Used in laboratory analysis, pH adjustment, and cleaning.
hazards: Corrosive. Can cause severe skin burns and eye damage.
ppe: Wear gloves, safety goggles, and a lab coat.
storage: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place.
green_alternative: Use weaker organic acids when possible.

name: Sulfuric Acid
uses: Used in titration, chemical synthesis, and battery experiments.
hazards: Highly corrosive. Reacts violently with water.
ppe: Wear gloves, goggles, face shield, and lab coat.
storage: Store in acid-resistant containers away from bases.
green_alternative: Use safer dilute acids whenever suitable.

name: Ethanol
uses: Used as a solvent, disinfectant, and laboratory fuel.
storage: Keep away from heat and open flames.

name: Acetone
uses: Used as a cleaning solvent and laboratory reagent.
hazards: May cause eye irritation and dizziness.
storage: Store tightly closed away from ignition sources.
